# GMEOW Employment Module

The GMEOW Employment Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/employment>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/employment`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Employment relationships, compensation, and career events (the ResumeRDF / Europass / schema.org / ESCO / CTDL superset layer).

STANDPOINT DOCTRINE (#51). Contested facts in the employment slice — disputed tenure, rival role claims, contested termination — are standpoint-indexed claims that COEXIST, none privileged (Principle 9). A contested employment is two gmeow:accordingTo-annotated gmeow:memberOf base triples, or two reified gmeow:Employment relators each carrying gmeow:accordingTo. A withdrawn employment record is modelled with gmeow:displayable false, never deletion (Principle 10). There is NO employment-specific dispute mechanism, no primaryEmployment, no preferredJob — only the cross-cutting #43 facility.

DOCTRINE.
  * Employment is a Membership: a reified gufo:Relator connecting an agent to an organization, optionally founded on an Agreement (Principle 4).
  * Employment events (hiring, promotion, transfer, resignation, termination) are value individuals in the EventType vocabulary, never subclasses (Principle 9).
  * Employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, intern) is an open value vocabulary, never a subclass taxonomy.
  * Compensation is a MonetaryAmount with explicit currency ReferenceFrame (Principle 11).
  * Seniority is an open value vocabulary, orthogonal to employment type and role.
  * Flat-first, reify on demand: a flat gmeow:memberOf covers the 80% case; promote to gmeow:Employment when type, compensation, seniority, or provenance matters.
  * Reuse: Membership, Role, Occupation, Agreement, Event/Participation, MonetaryAmount, Credential, Skill, LanguageProficiency.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/employment>
